What Apple LED Flash for Alerts is — and what your listing may claim

Apple ships LED Flash for Alerts under Settings → Accessibility → Audio & Visual → LED Flash for Alerts. When enabled, the rear camera LED flashes for incoming calls and notifications — especially valuable when the device is silent or face-down:

  • LED Flash for Alerts toggle (提示时闪烁 / LED 闪烁提示) — the master switch under Audio & Visual. Apple's official zh-Hans Settings label is LED 闪烁以示提醒 under 辅助功能 → 音频与视觉.
  • Silent-mode call flash (来电闪灯) — gallery frames showing the LED blink when ringtones are muted, vibration-only mode is on, or Focus silences audible alerts.
  • Face-down notification flash (闪光灯提示) — marketing when your English listing shows the LED activating while the phone rests screen-down on a table.
  • Flash Alerts compatibility badges — "Works with LED Flash for Alerts", "Visual alert for calls", or "See notifications with camera flash" overlays on communication or alert apps.
  • Flash LED for Alerts label variant — some en-US screenshots use Flash LED for Alerts instead of LED Flash for Alerts. zh-Hans caption lines should name the same feature per frame — not Camera photo flash or Flashlight torch vocabulary.

Your gallery may lead with a LED Flash for Alerts settings capture on one frame and a silent-mode call-flash demo on the next. zh-Hans caption lines should name the correct surface per frame — an Accessibility LED flash toggle is not a Sound Recognition alert dashboard and not a Notification Grouping Automatic / By App sheet.

LED Flash for Alerts is not Accessibility hub, Accessibility Access, Sound Recognition, or Announce Notifications

Accessibility-adjacent apps blur several shop guides indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — camera LED notification flash marketing on the product page:

  • LED Flash for Alerts (this page) — camera LED blinks for incoming calls and notifications when silent or face-down, Settings → Accessibility → Audio & Visual → LED Flash for Alerts, Flash LED for Alerts, Flash Alerts vocabulary — 提示时闪烁, LED 闪烁提示, 来电闪灯, 闪光灯提示.
  • Accessibility Settings hub (different) — Settings → Accessibility home, Accessibility Shortcut, AssistiveTouch, Guided Access, Display & Text Size, Voice Control as hub bullets — 辅助功能, 辅助功能快捷键. See Accessibility hub listing guide — multi-feature assistive grid, not a single LED flash toggle sheet.
  • Accessibility Access TCC (different) — Privacy & Security → Accessibility per-app grants for developer Accessibility API control — 辅助功能访问, 辅助功能权限. See Accessibility Access listing guide — developer AX permission panels, not consumer LED flash notification alerts.
  • Sound Recognition (different) — ambient environmental sound detection — baby crying, door knock, smoke alarm, glass break — 声音识别. See Sound Recognition listing guide — microphone listens for ambient sounds; LED Flash for Alerts blinks the camera LED for calls and notifications.
  • Background Sounds (different) — accessibility ambient focus audio loops under Settings → Accessibility — 背景音. See Background Sounds listing guide — continuous ambient audio playback, not camera LED strobe alerts.
  • Noise Monitoring (different) — Apple Watch / AirPods / Health environmental dB exposure tracking — 噪音监测. See Noise Monitoring listing guide — loudness exposure metering, not visual LED flash alerts.
  • Announce Notifications (different) — Siri reads notifications aloud through AirPods or CarPlay — 朗读通知. See Announce Notifications listing guide — spoken delivery, not camera LED flash.
  • AssistiveTouch & Voice Control (different) — floating on-screen assist menu — 辅助触控 — and spoken UI commands — 声音控制. See AssistiveTouch listing guide and Voice Control listing guide — motor and spoken input accessibility, not hearing visual-alert LED flash.

Your screenshots may show accessibility icons on adjacent frames. Listing copy should name the correct surface per frame — a LED Flash for Alerts toggle under Audio & Visual is not a Sound Recognition sound-type picker and not an Announce Notifications headphone speech demo.

LED Flash for Alerts is not Notification Grouping, Camera flash, or Flashlight

Notification and flash vocabulary indie teams merge on one product page. AppLocale covers Accessibility LED notification flash listing metadata — not unrelated surfaces:

  • LED Flash for Alerts (this page) — automatic rear camera LED blinks for calls and notifications under Accessibility — 提示时闪烁, LED 闪烁提示, 来电闪灯.
  • Notification Grouping (different) — per-app Automatic, By App, or Off thread stacking under Settings → Notifications — 通知分组. See Notification Grouping listing guide — how alerts stack, not how the camera LED flashes.
  • Camera photo flash (different) — rear LED strobe synchronized with the shutter when taking photos — 拍照闪光灯, 闪光灯同步. See In-app Camera listing guide and Camera Flash Sync listing guide — photo-capture flash, not notification LED blink.
  • Built-in Flashlight (different) — user-controlled torch from Control Center or Lock Screen — 手电筒. See Flashlight listing guide — persistent torch access, not automatic notification strobe.
  • Dim Flashing Lights (contrast only) — on-device detection and dimming of flashing lights in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. See Dim Flashing Lights listing guide — video strobe dimming, not notification LED blinks.

English shares "flash" across Camera, Flashlight, and LED Flash for Alerts — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate 拍照闪光灯 photo flash, 手电筒 torch, and 提示时闪烁 notification LED flash on the same frame unless each claim is labeled honestly.
